Welcome to Motions in Motion!

1. Connect at least three players, in addition to the display host. Four-player mode is not supported. Everyone readies up, then the host starts the game.
2. One player becomes the judge. The other players alternate between prosecution and defense. The host is the shared TV display and does not join a team.
3. The display host selects a case. Only that case's evidence is used. Each team receives its own evidence pile, and two random pieces begin on the court board.
4. The court calls one lawyer from the speaking team. Prosecution and defense each speak for four minutes, then repeat that order for another four minutes each. The final four minutes alternate one-minute turns: prosecution, defense, prosecution, defense.
5. Choose Motion for Evidence on your controller, then select a piece from your team's pile. Draw the delivery car's wheels and submit them. When the car crosses the finish line, the evidence replaces the oldest piece on the two-card court board.
6. Choose add objection to send an objection car. Draw fresh wheels for this delivery. If it arrives, Objection appears and the trial clock pauses while the objection music plays.
7. Each team can have only one delivery at a time, including while a teammate draws. Your team's buttons unlock after arrival, a crash, cancellation, or an expired delivery. Completely overturned cars are destroyed. You can cancel while drawing and try again.
8. After twenty minutes of speaking time, the judge chooses Guilty or Not guilty on their controller.

Listen to the person called to speak, help your team make its case, and draw wheels that can survive the road!
